title: Skeleton's Last Delivery
description: A skeletal figure dressed in a blue suit and fedora stands on a stack of bricks, holding two briefcases. A human skull rests on the bricks in front of him beside a wooden barrel and broken crate, with a gnarled dead tree and a large glowing orange sun in the background.
